name: seed sweep en+zh
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cd ~/bonsai2/asm && export OMP_NUM_THREADS=20 && for S in 8 9 11; do echo "########## EN seed $S"; taskset -c 0-19 ./fwd_mt ../models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf 826 279 2943 15127 321 799 3065 421 4203 303 1754 13 --gen 200 --sample 0.5 0.85 20 $S 2>/dev/null | grep "^step" | awk "NR>12" | sed "s/.*top=//;s/ .*//" | tr "\n" " " > /tmp/en_s$S.txt; echo; wc -w < /tmp/en_s$S.txt; done; for S in 8 9; do echo "########## ZH seed $S"; taskset -c 0-19 ./fwd_mt ../models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf 99270 115992 104647 3709 98404 98443 96681 96594 110476 127312 1710 --gen 300 --sample 0.5 0.85 20 $S 2>/dev/null | grep "^step" | awk "NR>11" | sed "s/.*top=//;s/ .*//" | tr "\n" " " > /tmp/zh_s$S.txt; echo; wc -w < /tmp/zh_s$S.txt; done; echo SWEEP_DONE' 2>&1 | head -14
